description: This file defines an interface for retry configuration in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifying methods to access retry mode, maximum attempts, and configuration as an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface providing access to retry configuration settings in the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the retry mode, such as 'legacy', 'standard', or 'adaptive'.

methods.name: getMaxAttempts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of attempts for a request.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the retry configuration as an associative array.
